title: Set explicit Content-Security-Policy on Meads webview
description: vscode/src/webview.ts emits no CSP meta tag, so it relies on VS Code's default permissive CSP for webviews with scripts enabled. A future VS Code release could tighten the default and break the iframe. Add a <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> tag whitelisting frame-src for the iframe origin (and connect-src for the websocket). The origin will be dynamic — derive it from info.url (post-asExternalUri).
